paper.title:
Physics of Language Models: Part 3.1, Knowledge Storage and Extraction Thanks: Project page: https://physics.allen-zhu.com/part-3-knowledge/part-3-1 . An extended video of this paper is available at https://youtu.be/YSHzKmEianc .

result.summary: 这篇论文研究自回归语言模型如何在预训练中记忆事实知识、并在推理时提取这些知识，作者用可控的合成传记数据集（bioS 与 Llama 生成的 bioR）进行实验 [S1.p6][S2.p1]。作者发现，仅在传记上预训练再指令微调时，模型几乎无法对未见过 QA 的个体进行知识提取，无论模型规模、预训练时长或微调参数如何 [S1.p8][S4.SS1.p2]。加入知识增强（多重表述、句子置换、重复全名）后，提取准确率大幅提升，例如从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。作者进一步用近线性探测（P-probing 与 Q-probing）表明，知识增强使属性几乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏表示中，从而支持微调时的知识提取 [S1.p8][S5.SS1.p4]。作者据此建议在预训练阶段对关键但稀少的数据进行改写增强，并更早引入指令微调数据 [S1.p9][S8.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型在训练中如何记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识，尤其是模型回答“林肯出生在哪个城市”这类问题时，是真正从传记等来源中提取知识，还是因为在训练中见过相似或相同的问题而记住了答案 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，难以区分这两种情况，因此需要可控实验 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we explore how transformer-based language models memorize knowledge during training and extract it during inference.

leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
Given the challenges of conducting controlled experiments with internet data, we propose studying this question using well-controlled, synthetically generated data

method.text: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS 和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，每个个体包含出生日期、出生城市、大学、专业、雇主、工作城市六个属性 [S2.p1][S2.p4][A1.SS1.p1]。训练流程包括：在全部传记上预训练，再用一部分个体的 QA 对进行指令微调，并在未见过 QA 的剩余个体上做分布外测试 [S1.p7]。作者还提出两种近线性探测方法——基于位置的 P-probing 和基于查询的 Q-probing，用于检查知识在隐藏状态中的编码位置 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we introduce synthetic human biography datasets and near-real datasets generated by LLaMa.
We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.
Each individual’s first, middle, and last names, birth date, birth city, university attended, major of study, and current employer are selected independently and randomly from a uniform distribution.
After pretraining the model on the entire biography, we fine-tune it using question and answer (QA) pairs from a $p$ fraction of individuals.
We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing).

experiments.text: 实验使用 N=100,000 个个体的传记数据，bioS 为合成数据，bioR 由 Llama 生成 [S2.p4][A1.SS1.p1]。模型采用 GPT2/Llama 架构，bioS 使用 12 层 12 头 768 维（124M）模型，bioR 使用 12 层 20 头 1280 维（302M）模型，负结果中还尝试了 682M 模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。混合训练中，模型从零开始在全部 BIO 数据和一半 QA 数据上训练，QA 数据比例参数 QA_r 主要设为 0.8 [S2.SS1.p4]。评估使用剩余 QA 数据，QA 准确率按答案完全匹配的比例计算 [S2.p6]。

evidence.quote: For the set of $N=100,000$ individuals, we provide an instructive prompt to Llama to generate a biographical entry.
In the synthetic dataset labeled as bioS, we generate profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
Only in Figure 2 when presenting a negative result, we tried a 12-layer 32-head 2048-dim GPT2 (682M).
In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.
primarily setting ${\mathsf{QA}_{r}}=0.8$ (a $2:8$ BIO to QA entry ratio)
QA accuracy is measured by the proportion of answers that exactly match the correct response.

findings.text: 在混合训练中，模型先用 QA 编码 p 部分个体的知识，再与传记关联，从而泛化到剩余 1-p 部分 [S1.p8]。但仅在传记上预训练再 QA 微调时，模型在测试个体上的 QA 准确率为零，即使模型规模约为 N 的 7000 倍、每个个体在预训练中暴露 1350 次 [S4.SS1.p2]。加入知识增强后，例如每人 5 条不同措辞的传记条目，QA 微调准确率从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。P-probing 显示，在 bioS single 中公司名属性在目标属性前一个 token 之前准确率仅约 2%，而在 bioS multi5+permute 中六个属性从第一个特殊位置起准确率接近 100% [S5.SS1.p4]。此外，仅对“名人”子集做知识增强，也能显著提升未增强“少数群体”的测试准确率 [S1.p8]。双向模型如 BERT 在 MLM 预训练后，除非知识是单个词或相互独立的词（如月、日、年），否则难以提取知识 [S1.p8][S7.p8]。

evidence.quote: the model first uses QAs to encode knowledge about the $p$ fraction, then correlates this encoded knowledge with the biography to infer generalization to the remaining $1-p$ fraction
the model exhibits zero-zero QA accuracy on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$ for all finetuning parameters
This holds true even when the model size is $\sim$ 7000x larger than $N=100k$, with each individual exposed 1350 times during pretraining

Pretraining on a dataset where each person has 5 diverse biography entries (i.e., different wording, sentence shuffling) boosts the QA fine-tune accuracy (on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) from 9.7% to 96.6%.
In the bioS single setup, P-probing accuracy remains low (e.g., 2% for company name) until the token immediately preceding the target attribute (where accuracy boosts to 100%).
In the heavily augmented setup like bioS multi5+permute, the P-probing accuracy for all six attributes rises to nearly 100% from the first special position, which is before all of the attributes.
Even if knowledge augmentation is applied to a subset of individuals, what we call celebrities, test accuracy for others (without augmentation) also increases significantly.
Unless the knowledge is a standalone word or of independent words (like month, day, year), extracting knowledge after MLM pretraining might prove challenging, if not totally impossible.

limitations.text: 作者指出，P-probing 依赖传记条目的精确上下文结构，可能因此受限 [S5.SS2.p1]。作者还提到，翻译增强（如英译法）对知识提取有益，但为清晰起见未在论文中纳入这些细节 [S4.SS2.p2]。此外，作者表示对负结果（如 bioS single）尝试 LoRA 更新并未显著提高 P-probing 准确率，因此省略了细节 [S5.SS1.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, it can be limiting due to its dependence on the exact context structure from the biography entry.

As a special case, we also experimented with translation (e.g., English to French) to increase sentence diversity, which proved beneficial for the model’s knowledge extraction, but we have not included these details in this paper for clarity.
However, our experiments showed no significant increase in P-probing accuracies, so we omit the details.
